items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because Spud Murphy... Do you remember Spud Murphy? You've heard of him, right? [INTERVIEWER] Sure.

ctx.x: And Gene was... You were pretty tight before you joined the band.

Well, we'd got tight from making that thing, you know, "Swing Is Here." That was my tune, too, and they jumped in on that. In fact, there's a melody floating around... I think I made a record with that melody in France, called "Leila Doll" or something like that. Because Spud Murphy... Do you remember Spud Murphy? You've heard of him, right?
